title: Extracted facts (Person A → Person B input contract)
description: Person A hands Person B either an array of extracted facts, or an object with a 'facts' array. The loader is tolerant of missing optional fields and of a few field-name aliases (see README).

property_id.description: Stable id for the property, e.g. 'kelso-villa'. Used as the grouping key. Falls back to a slug of property_name.

property_name.description: Human-readable name and preferably the address, e.g. 'Kelso Villa, Upper Bristol Road, Bath BA1 3AU'.

field.description: Core fields: price, tenure, net_floor_area, gross_floor_area, energy_rating, parking. Aliases such as epc, nia, gia, asking_price are accepted and normalised.

value.description: The extracted value. Numbers may be numeric or formatted strings ('£700,000', '1,990'). Tenure and ratings are strings.

unit.description: GBP, sqft, sqm, or null. Aliases such as '£', 'sq ft', 'm²' are accepted.

area_basis.description: net, gross, or null. Aliases: NIA, GIA, ipms, etc. Net and gross are kept as separate resolved facts and are never a conflict.

doc_id.description: Stable document id, e.g. the PDF filename or listing id.

doc_type.description: brochure | listing | official_record. Aliases: land_registry, epc_register, land-registry are treated as official_record for precedence.

published_date.description: ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD) or datetime. Preferred date for ordering.

retrieved_date.description: ISO date the fact was retrieved. Used if published_date is missing.

page.description: 1-based page number in the source document.

quote.description: Verbatim excerpt containing the value, used in the review UI.

extraction_confidence.description: Optional 0–1 confidence from Person A's extractor.

stated_equivalent.description: When a document states two units as equivalent (e.g. '185 sq m / 2,700 sq ft'). The engine checks the arithmetic and flags a wrong conversion as UNIT_MISMATCH, not two areas.

scope.description: development | unit. A development-wide claim is not copied onto a unit.

unit_type.description: House type. Different plots or types are never merged.

entity_match_confidence.description: 0–1. Below the threshold (default 0.7), the fact is held unmatched and no conflict is raised.

quote_attribution.description: Whether the quote is taken from the product spec, reconstructed from a PDF transcript, or from a listing field.
